operation_details.item: The user resolved the payment gateway incident.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! Saw the payment gateway incident ticket closed. Looks like you got it sorted?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, I resolved it. Quick hotfix in the checkout service. The timeline is documented, so if anyone asks, we have the sequence.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice work. Did you write any tests for the fix?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Tests? Nah, just verified it manually against a staging cart. Tests would slow us down. Root cause analysis is in progress though, so we'll see what actually happened.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Next week. We'll blame the timeout config and call it a day. But at least the payments are flowing now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Ha. I'll make sure to grab a coffee for that meeting. So the timeline doc is the only write-up?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty much. I hate writing docs, but my manager insisted. It's just bullet points. Good enough.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I resolved the payment gateway incident; keep the timeline, root cause work, and postmortem.
